terra.problem: “No refusing, no arguing” states more than the text says. It records Hosea going and marrying Gomer, but does not describe whether he initially objected.
“No pushing back, no refusing” presents the absence of an objection in the account as proof that no objection occurred.
The statement that Israel was the northern kingdom is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
“Wrong address” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer. The statement that Judah was the southern kingdom also needs an outside reference.
Calling the answer “way out in left field” puts down the baker’s choice. The claims that Moab was another nation and a neighboring country also need outside references.
The statement that Samaria was Israel’s capital is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
“No treaties” adds to the means of rescue the LORD rules out. The passage does not mention treaties.
